verdict.rationale: Riveter lets users build enrichments from natural-language prompts (riveter-docs-2, riveter-docs-12) and exposes itself via MCP so it can be driven by natural language through Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible assistant (riveter-docs-9, riveter-docs-20), directly matching the ai-native/agenticness story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond docs, and evidence that all product actions (not just enrichment creation) are controllable via NL rather than structured API calls.
